name: Stamp Duty Refund
benefit: 1. **General Industrial Units:** 100% refund in 'D' category blocks; 75% in 'C' category blocks and 60% in 'B' category blocks on the land meant for industrial use, after commencement of commercial production within 5 years from the date of purchase of land.1. **Thrust Sectors/Bio Energy Enterprises [MSME]:** 100% refund in ‘C’ and 'D' category blocks; 80% in ‘B&#39
_eligibility_text:
**Industrial Units (MSME, Large, Mega)** 1. Must commence commercial production after 01.01.2021 and within 5 years from the date of land purchase. 1. Land must be purchased before 31.12.2025. 1. Must file IEM/Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) and Haryana Udhyam Memorandum (HUM). 1. Not listed in the restrictive/negative list of the State Government. 1. Must have NOC/CLU, if applicable. 1. Unit must be in commercial production. 1. Must remain in production for at least 5 years.
**General Category Units** 1. Eligible under same criteria as MSME/Large units, even if not covered under thrust sectors.
**Industrial Parks / Estates (Developers) -** 1. Minimum area of 25 acres. 1. Must obtain Industrial License/NOC from competent authority. 1. Refund applicable after full infrastructure development. 1. Infrastructure must be developed within 5 years of land purchase (land purchased before 31.12.2025).
